notes: STAND-IN fixture (scripts/make_fixtures.py) so the demo can switch scenarios. Shaimaa's simulator replaces it. All values are simulated.

expected_outcomes: Follow-up opens as review_requested immediately, assigned to the medical team
A consult summary is prepared for the medical team (share preview, private notes excluded)
Today's Decode is within the usual range and is shown, but never delays or hides the review
The symptom stays listed; no temperature value is invented
simulator_scenario.scenario_clock_basis: UTC on a fictional mission calendar (day 27 = 2026-11-14)

self_report.symptom_text: Onset 2026-11-14 · Severity: moderate · Headache and feeling hot since waking; felt warm to the touch (no thermometer reading taken)

personal_reference.method: Median of valid past sessions in a 14-day window, excluding the first two sessions
personal_reference.eligibility_notes: Demonstration heuristic using 5 valid sessions in 14 days, not a medical threshold.

finding.explanation: A reported symptom today: headache and feeling hot since waking.
finding.limitations: A self-report with no temperature reading. The medical team decides what it means; a good Decode result does not change this.

action.reason_text: A reported symptom needs a specialist's view.
action.action_text: Request a review by the medical team

share_package.summary_text: Sequence: symptom reported 07:10 (headache, feeling hot since waking; no thermometer reading); medical review requested 07:11; Decode completed 07:31:30. Measurements: resting pulse 62 bpm, recorded sleep 7.0 h, Decode 47 correct answers within the personal range 46-48 from 5 prior sessions (reference ref-1.0). The Decode result does not close the symptom review. Actions tried: none yet. Question: please review the symptom.

sharing_permission.consent_basis: Previewed and confirmed by the astronaut

daily_review.review_explanation: Recorded: sleep, resting pulse, alertness, Decode, a reported symptom. Changed: a symptom needing review. A good Decode result does not close or delay the review.
